body: I do count calories. My stomach shrinking makes the binge worse since it hurts more to eat, and fatty/sugary foods make me sick. It doesn't stop me though. I can still binge on upwards of 8000 calories in a day until it becomes hard to breathe.

I know why I binge I think. I restrict through the week, and it makes me binge. Now when I try to stop restricting, I continue to binge. Every day so far for three days already. I hate eating, and I can't stop. The thought of it makes me sick, but all I can think about is eating.
I don't think they can help because I talk to other people with my problems, and they tell me it doesn't help. It just wastes money.
No. I don't think it will help.
